title: Forty Questions: Identifying a Language Model from One-Word Answers
abstract: arXiv:2610.28281v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A model behind an API can be identified from its one-word answers to everyday questions such as "Name a sound" or "Name a poet". A model's profile records how often it gives each answer to each question. We attribute new answers to the model most likely to have given them. On a panel of 94 models, 40 answers identify the exact model 92.5% of the time, against 1.1% by chance. Profiles built through OpenRouter identified all ten models served by DeepInfra under blinded labels. A system prompt lowers accuracy by 6 to 16 points. We applied the method to 96 endpoints of 13 open models on OpenRouter, and 92 identify as the model they claim. Of the other four, one matches the claimed model with reasoning turned off. One serves Gemma 4 under the name Llama 4 Maverick: it names itself Gemma 4, and it is billed Gemma 4's token counts on every message. Two remain unresolved. translated_title: 四十个问题：从单词式回答识别语言模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：API背后的模型可以通过其对日常问题（如“说出一种声音”或“说出一位诗人”）的单词式回答被识别出来。模型的档案记录了它对每个问题给出每个答案的频率，我们据此将新的回答归因于最有可能给出该回答的模型。在一个包含94个模型的测试面板上，40个回答能够以92.5%的准确率识别出确切的模型，而随机猜测的准确率仅为1.1%。通过OpenRouter构建的档案在盲测条件下成功识别了DeepInfra所服务的全部十个模型。系统提示词会将识别准确率降低6至16个百分点。我们将该方法应用于OpenRouter上13个开放模型的96个端点，其中92个端点被识别为其声称的模型。在其余四个端点中，一个在关闭推理功能时与声称的模型匹配；一个以Llama 4 Maverick的名义实际提供Gemma 4服务：它自称是Gemma 4，且每条消息都按Gemma 4的token计数计费；另外两个端点尚无法确认。计费记录还显示第一方模型被添加了额外上下文。Grok 4.7是
tldr: 本文提出仅通过40个日常问题的单词式回答即可构建模型“指纹”，以92.5%的准确率精确识别API背后的语言模型，并据此揭露了模型端点伪装、计费异常及隐藏系统提示等实际问题。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a language model behind an API can be fingerprinted with 92.5% accuracy from just 40 one-word answers to everyday questions, exposing mislabeled endpoints, billing anomalies, and hidden system prompts in real-world deployments.
